assembly: Sha384._block: SHA-384 compression in assembly: the plain Solidity version cost 2.8 million gas per event log. Checked against a reference implementation and NIST vectors.
assembly: Sha384.rotr: Part of the SHA-384 compression written in assembly (see Sha384._block).
assembly: TdxQuoteVerifier._hashBody: Hashes a slice of the verifier's output without copying it.
assembly: TdxQuoteVerifier._word: Reads one word of the verifier's output; bounds are checked by the callers.
